submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 at a 30 GeV threshold is the best-performing scanned configuration among the three allowed candidates, with a fine-scan signal efficiency of 93.071%. This exceeds the best fine-scan efficiencies for Algorithm-L1 (86.63% at 35 GeV) and Algorithm-L3 (74.408% at 30 GeV). The threshold is within the allowed 20--60 GeV range, and all candidates are recorded as fitting the FPGA resource budget with sufficient optical links. However, the Level-1 latency for Algorithm-L2 is not stated in the recorded project results, so compliance with the hard 4.0 us latency requirement is unknown and must be verified before deployment.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Fine scan selected Algorithm-L2 at 30 GeV with the highest recorded efficiency, 93.071%, compared with Algorithm-L1 best 86.63% and Algorithm-L3 best 74.408%. Rate allocation recorded as 8 kHz; the selected point is the recorded optimum from the simulation scan.

requirements.evidence: latency_us_Algorithm_L2 = -1, latency_us_Algorithm_L2_not_stated = -1, latency_unknown_Algorithm_L2 = 1, and selected_latency_us = -1. No candidate was discarded for documented latency > 4 us, but compliance is not demonstrated.
